input.command:
python3 -c "
# Now let's calculate the true 3D bounding box and center of the sofa:
# South-West corner (Apex facing camera from south):
# obs_0030: (2.435, 5.724)
# obs_0055: (2.354, 5.724)
# obs_0065: (2.498, 5.690)
# Mean SW corner: x ≈ 2.43, y ≈ 5.71

# South-East corner (Right corner of South face):
# obs_0030: (3.330, 5.724)
# obs_0055: (3.247, 5.724)
# Mean SE corner: x ≈ 3.29, y ≈ 5.72

# North-West corner (Far left corner along North-South axis):
# obs_0030: x ≈ 2.62, y ≈ 8.20 (North wall is at y ≈ 8.20)
# obs_0045: x ≈ 2.52, y ≈ 8.20
# obs_0055: x ≈ 2.36, y ≈ 8.20
# Mean NW corner: x ≈ 2.43, y ≈ 8.20

# North-East corner (Against East and North wall):
# x ≈ 3.29, y ≈ 8.20

# Therefore, the sofa is oriented along the North-South axis:
# x extends from 2.43 to 3.29 (width = 0.86 m)
# y extends from 5.71 to 8.20 (length = 2.49 m)

# Center of sofa:
x_center = (2.43 + 3.29) / 2.0
y_center = (5.71 + 8.20) / 2.0
print(f'Sofa / Armchair true ground center: x = {x_center:.3f}, y = {y_center:.3f}')
"
